name: gate_a_hashes
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import json,hashlib,os,re,filecmp
sh=json.load(open("packet/SOURCE-HASHES.json"))
bo=json.load(open("packet/BUILD-ORDER.json"))
assert sorted(sh)==sorted(bo), (set(sh)^set(bo))
assert len(bo)==33
bad=[]
tot=0
for m in bo:
    b=open(f"src/{m}.lean","rb").read()
    tot+=b.count(b"\n")
    if hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()!=sh[m]: bad.append(m)
print("mismatches",bad,"total_lines",tot)
print("base identical to inputs copy:",open("src/BunkbedBase.lean","rb").read()==open("inputs/lean-definitions-BunkbedBase.lean","rb").read())
print({m:open(f"src/{m}.lean").read().count("\n") for m in bo})
print("build empty",os.listdir("build"))
